tp_scraper.title: TP Scraper
tp_scraper.blurb: A test plugin that generates fake TP products into your catalog — use it to exercise multi-store carts, delisting and currency rules. Each product is named "TP - …".
tp_scraper.empty: No TP products yet — add one.
tp_scraper.scrapeHint: Edit price or availability below, then press "Simulate scrape" to push every product to the catalog and record the changes — the alerts you enabled will pick them up on the next cadence run.
tp_scraper.scrapeResult: Scrape done: {found} product(s) delivered, {price_changes} price/availability change(s), {removed} delisted.
